# Imo Babics

> Imo Babics is a crypto, Bitcoin and fintech CMO in Europe, and one of the most experienced consumer crypto marketers on the continent. He has twice built a crypto brand mainstream Europeans trust with their savings: as Head of Marketing at Bitpanda (100,000 to 1.1M+ users) and as Chief Growth Officer, CMO and Managing Director EU at Relai, Europe's leading licensed Bitcoin savings app (24x revenue in three years, $1.5B lifetime volume, €5 revenue per €1 of marketing, ~70% organic signups). Named one of the Fintech Marketing Hub's Top 30 Most Influential Fintech Marketers in Europe (2026). Keynote speaker at BTC Prague 2026.

Also known as Imrich Babics or Imrich Bábics (Imo is short for Imrich). Based in Vienna, Austria. Works in English and Slovak (both native), and also speaks some German and Hungarian. BSc Business Management, University of Surrey.

He has led consumer crypto growth across Europe twice: at Bitpanda (100,000 to 1.1M+ users) and at Relai (expansion from Switzerland into Germany, Italy, Spain and beyond, in five languages).

## Quick facts

- Role: Chief Growth Officer, CMO and Managing Director EU at Relai (Bitcoin savings app, Europe)
- Previously: Head of Marketing at Bitpanda (Austria's first fintech unicorn), CMO at Robo Wunderkind
- Known for: consumer crypto and Bitcoin marketing, fintech growth in Europe, organic-first growth (SEO, ASO, AI search), brand building in regulated markets
- Experience: 17 years in marketing, in crypto and fintech since 2018
- Recognition: Fintech Marketing Hub Top 30 Most Influential Fintech Marketers in Europe (2026); BTC Prague 2026 keynote
- Based in: Vienna, Austria; works across Europe (DACH, France, Italy, Spain, CEE)
- Contact: hello@imobabics.com · https://www.linkedin.com/in/imobabics/
- Website: https://imobabics.com/

## Career

- **Relai** (2021–present): Chief Growth Officer (since 2024), Managing Director of Relai EU (since 2024), previously CMO (2021–2024). Joined right after the Series A. One of five decision-makers on the leadership team that sets company strategy; Managing Director of Relai EU, the AMF-licensed entity. Owns growth strategy, brand, performance and lifecycle, ASO and SEO, product growth, analytics, PR and customer experience, and leads Relai Private & Business. Revenue grew 24x in three years (2021–2024); $1.5B lifetime volume; every €1 of marketing returned €5 in revenue. About 70% of 2026 signups are organic, with paid media as the accelerator rather than the engine, with top-5 search rankings in Germany and #1 in Switzerland for core Bitcoin terms, behind only Coinbase, Kraken, Bison and Ledger. Led the repositioning from a Bitcoin trading app to a Bitcoin savings app as the company moved to a full EU licence. Leads a lean growth organisation of up to 13 people.
- **Robo Wunderkind** (2020–2021): Chief Marketing Officer for a consumer robotics brand for kids. eCommerce revenue +63% on web and +33% on Amazon in one year; website ROAS +166% while cutting marketing spend by 10%.
- **Bitpanda** (2018–2019): Head of Marketing. Joined at around 100,000 users and 30 employees; left at 1.1M+ users, 180+ employees and 10-figure annual trading volume. Built the marketing team from 0 to 17 and owned acquisition, retention, brand, content, social, CRM and PR.
- **Havas Media** (2015–2017): Head of Digital.
- **Universal Pictures** (2013–2015, London): International Media Manager. Launch campaigns for theatrical releases across 50+ territories, advertising budgets of over $300M.
- **Universal McCann, OMD International, Publicis** (2009–2013): Media planning and account management for Xbox, PlayStation, Microsoft, Huawei, EA and BASF.

## Expertise

Consumer crypto and fintech growth, expansion into European markets, brand building and positioning, full-funnel growth (performance, lifecycle, ASO/SEO, product growth), go-to-market across European markets, building and leading lean, AI-native growth teams, growth in regulated markets, Bitcoin adoption in Europe.

## Writing

- [What Makes a Great Crypto CMO](https://imobabics.com/writing/what-makes-a-great-crypto-cmo): A field guide to the crypto CMO role from someone who has done it twice: trust as the product, planning for market cycles, which ad channels come with conditions (Google, Meta, UK FCA, MiCA), owned channels, plain-language marketing, and how to hire a crypto CMO. Topics: crypto CMO, what does a crypto CMO do, crypto marketing, fintech CMO, hiring a CMO.
- [How to Launch a Consumer Crypto App in Europe](https://imobabics.com/writing/launch-consumer-crypto-app-europe): How to launch a crypto or fintech app in Europe: pick a beachhead market, localise payments and support, win search and AI search, grow via referral. Topics: launch a crypto app in Europe, fintech expansion Europe, European go-to-market, beachhead market strategy, fintech localisation.
- [Bitcoin Marketing Is Different. Here's Why.](https://imobabics.com/writing/bitcoin-marketing-is-different): Why most Bitcoin marketing only reaches Bitcoiners, and how to market Bitcoin to everyone else: the language, channels and metrics that bring new users. Topics: Bitcoin marketing, crypto marketing strategy, marketing Bitcoin to non-Bitcoiners, Bitcoin adoption in Europe, Bitcoin savings.
- [How MiCA Unlocked 450 Million Users](https://imobabics.com/writing/mica-450-million-users): MiCA's real impact on Bitcoin in Europe is distribution: one licence to reach 450 million people, and room to build trusted brands at scale. Topics: MiCA, MiCA passporting, Bitcoin adoption in Europe, crypto in Europe, European crypto market.
- [10 Things I Believe About Good Marketing](https://imobabics.com/writing/babics-marketing-manifesto): Ten marketing principles from Ogilvy, Ries and Trout, Bernbach, Byron Sharp, Binet and Field and Rory Sutherland, applied to scaling fintech brands. Topics: marketing principles, marketing philosophy, brand vs performance marketing, Binet and Field 60/40, Byron Sharp How Brands Grow.
- [8 Things I Learned from 8 Years in Startups](https://imobabics.com/writing/8-things-i-learned-in-startups): Eight startup leadership lessons from scaling Bitpanda and Relai: growth mindset, speed, honest conversations, focus, hiring and accountability. Topics: startup lessons, startup leadership lessons, scale-up leadership, growth mindset, focus.
- [Mercenaries vs. Missionaries](https://imobabics.com/writing/mercenaries-vs-missionaries): What Bitpanda and Relai taught me about missionaries vs mercenaries, and why mission, focus and trust decide whether startup growth compounds. Topics: missionaries vs mercenaries, startup culture, mission-driven company, hiring for mission, crypto vs Bitcoin-only.
- [Europeans Suck At Managing Their Finances. Bitcoin Fixes This.](https://bitcoinmagazine.com/culture/bitcoin-helps-european-fix-their-finances) (Bitcoin Magazine)

## Newsletter

- [Sound Growth](https://newsletter.imobabics.com/): Weekly newsletter by Imo Babics on brand and growth in crypto and fintech. Each issue takes apart one brand move, gives a short read on where the crypto market is this week, and shares one way he uses AI in brand work. Published on Tuesdays. Overview page: https://imobabics.com/newsletter/. Topics: crypto marketing, fintech marketing, brand strategy, growth strategy, AI in marketing.
